Keep unsandboxed kernels untouched. Run sandbox tests to verify.

Wire `WebSession` in `src/quartz/web/web_session.py` to persist and restore this toggle. Run session and web tests to verify.

Update prompt helper docs in `src/quartz/kernel/helpers.py` and `src/quartz/core/prompt.py`. Run helper tests to verify.
